test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb, 2026 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question, set of letter clusters are given. The letter clusters of each set are related to the letter clusters of the same set by some Logic/Rule/Relation. From the given alternatives, select a group of letter clusters which follows the same Logic/Rule/Relation.

(ND, PF, RH)

(QP, SR, UT)
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73ee2b3506d6333f7f2b9f5844f300c5eb8082e25fe7e02d250e8e0329479e39.png] Logic followed here is: In each set of letter clusters, the first and second letters of each subsequent cluster are obtained by adding +2 to the positional values of the corresponding letters in the preceding cluster. **For (ND, PF, RH) →**
